question: Can registered stellar-light or X-ray morphology supply the missing environmental tensor direction even before a spectroscopy-derived gas-mass map exists?

weak_field_equation.matter_split: Phi=Phi_N+phi_Sigma with fixed RAR for matter
weak_field_equation.discrete_structural_choice: one predeclared proxy mixture and one of contrast/full tensor

proxy_maps.gas_sqrt_proxy: square root of the same count-rate morphology; density-like only under an intentionally naive constant-depth, constant-emissivity approximation
proxy_maps.amplitude_rule: each component is normalized to unit weight before a frozen mixture; neither flux nor counts set gravity amplitude

tensor_coupling.ellipticity_preserving_domain: abs(t)<1 because every proxy tensor is normalized to eigenvalue magnitude at most one

cluster_split.within_family_rule: hold out the lexicographically last image in every family with at least three images
cluster_split.disclosure: all clusters are spent at project level, but validation proxy-tensor scores remain unread until the structural candidate is chosen on the selection clusters

screen.selection_metric: equal-system local training RMS on the two selection clusters
screen.candidate_diversity_rule: retain only the best nonzero t for each morphology/operator pair before taking the four best pairs

exact_selection.eligibility: all exact training and held-out roots converge in both selection clusters
exact_selection.choice: minimum equal-system exact training RMS among eligible nonzero candidates; always retain t=0 as control

validation.rule: score the single exact-selection choice and t=0 on the two different validation clusters

claim_limits: X-ray brightness is not projected gas mass; linear and square-root transformations are morphology stress tests only.
F160W is a light proxy with mass-to-light, foreground/background, and masking uncertainty.
The compressed pseudo-source catalog preserves coarse shape, not native image resolution.
This is a first-order projected weak-field closure, not a covariant field theory.
Galaxy and Solar scores are inherited unchanged only because this candidate is explicitly an external cluster-environment tensor; that restriction itself would need a universal covariant definition.
No formula can be promoted without a spectroscopy-derived gas surface-density map and independent clusters.
